summary: Iteration 2 testing for AI Sathi (auto-speak chip, document summary + action items, web camera modal). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passing including new bill summary, simple-text spoken_message, and pure-noise polite-fallback scenarios. Frontend: all critical flows verified on mobile viewport (auto-speak toggle ON↔OFF, debounced EN→NE translation, play/stop button label, copy-clipboard, language swap, translate-now, gallery upload no-crash, reset clears state, web camera modal opens with graceful error UI when no camera, close button dismisses modal).

issues: Non-blocking RN-web deprecation warnings still in console: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow), TouchableWithoutFeedback (use Pressable), props.pointerEvents (use style.pointerEvents). Same as iteration 1.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Silence RN-web deprecation warnings — does not affect functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/translate-image: 3-step pipeline (OCR→translate→summarize) is well-structured. JSON parsing strips ```json fences and falls back to translation when summary JSON parse fails — robust.

Bill PNG test confirmed: summary='यो एक्सवाइजेड पानी कम्पनीको पानीको बिल हो।', spoken_message includes amount ($50) + due date (Dec 15 2026) in Nepali, action_items=['डिसेम्बर १५, २०२६ सम्ममा ५० डलर तिर्नुहोस्।'].
Pure-noise image returns 200 with non-empty spoken_message (no 500) — handled correctly.
index.tsx: auto-speak toggle properly gates speakAfter only on translate-now (typing debounce never auto-speaks). Good UX.
index.tsx: WebCameraModal snap button is conditionally rendered only when stream is ready & no error — correct branching; error UI shows 'Could not access camera' and close button is always present.
index.tsx: handleSpeakOutput prefers summary when available, else translated_text — matches spec where summary is the headline output.
index.tsx: pickVoiceOptions correctly returns available:false when no Nepali voice exists, surfaces voiceWarning in UI.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_translator_api.py (added 3 new tests: bill summary, simple-text spoken_message, pure-noise polite-fallback)
seed_data_creation: None — backend is stateless. Test images generated in-memory via PIL (water-bill PNG, HELLO WORLD PNG, random-noise PNG).
